name: Segregated Independent Amount Margin 1
definition: Elements used to calculate the collateral margin call for the segregated independent amount.

MinimumTransferAmount.name: Minimum Transfer Amount
MinimumTransferAmount.definition: Minimum amount to pay/receive as specified in the agreement in the base currency (to avoid the need to transfer an inconveniently small amount of segregated independent amount).

RoundingAmount.name: Rounding Amount
RoundingAmount.definition: Amount specified to avoid the need to transfer uneven amounts of independent amount collateral.

RoundingMethod.name: Rounding Method
RoundingMethod.definition: Defines how the rounding amount was applied in the calculation. For example, should the amount of collateral required be rounded up, down, to the closer integral multiple specified or not rounded.
